journey.name: Discover — trending tags, add friend, follow
journey.description: Social discovery: trending tag chips from the Nexus staging indexer, add a friend by pubky, follow them, and open one of their decks (foreign-deck remote load). Requires a signed-in session (journey 01). The friend pubky used below must exist on staging and have at least one published Echo deck — substitute a known staging pubky before running, or accept the follow/profile steps as the verification target.

actions.action: Launch the Echo app and verify the Home screen is shown
Open the Discover tab from the bottom tab bar
Verify the Discover screen is shown with an "Add friend" button
Verify a bottom sheet appears with a "Paste a pubky" input, a "Scan QR" button and an "Open" button
If a "Trending on Pubky" section with tag chips is visible, tap the first trending tag chip and verify the deck list filters (decks with the tag, or a "No decks tagged" empty state)
If a tag chip is selected, tap it again to clear the filter
